execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."account_reactivation_requests" (
  "block_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "reviewed_at" timestamptz,
  "reviewed_by" uuid,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "account_reactivation_requests_status_check_56005a61" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."addresses" (
  "area" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "city" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "country" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "district" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "house_no" character varying(100),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "landmark" character varying(255),
  "latitude" numeric(10,7),
  "longitude" numeric(10,7),
  "pincode" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "state" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "type" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."categories" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(500),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image" character varying(500),
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "categories_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customer_profiles" (
  "about" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "profile_image" character varying(500),
  "service_radius_km" int4 DEFAULT 20,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" json,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "message" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "recipient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "title_code" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "type" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."provider_availability" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "day_of_week" text NOT NULL,
  "end_time" character varying(5) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "provider_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "start_time" character varying(5) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "provider_availability_day_of_week_check_a42e429c" CHECK ("day_of_week" IN ('MONDAY', 'TUESDAY', 'WEDNESDAY', 'THURSDAY', 'FRIDAY', 'SATURDAY', 'SUNDAY'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."provider_availability_overrides" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "end_time" character varying(5),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "override_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "provider_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" character varying(255),
  "start_time" character varying(5),
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "provider_availability_overrides_type_check_b3c23fd3" CHECK ("type" IN ('DAY_OFF', 'CUSTOM_HOURS'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."provider_profiles" (
  "accepting_leads" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "bio" character varying(2000) NOT NULL,
  "business_name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "completed_jobs" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "experience" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "kyc_status" text DEFAULT 'NOT_SUBMITTED' NOT NULL,
  "profile_image" character varying(500),
  "service_radius_km" int4 DEFAULT 20,
  "skills" character varying(1000),
  "travel_buffer_minutes" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "provider_profiles_kyc_status_check_624ac8d0" CHECK ("kyc_status" IN ('NOT_SUBMITTED', 'PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."provider_services" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "provider_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "service_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."provider_verification_documents" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "document_name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "document_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "provider_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "rejection_reason" character varying(500),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "provider_verification_documents_document_type_check_c7e0d7aa" CHECK ("document_type" IN ('IDENTITY', 'CERTIFICATE')),
  CONSTRAINT "provider_verification_documents_status_check_56005a61" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."provider_verification_files" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "document_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "file_url" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."services" (
  "category_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(1000),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image" character varying(500),
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "services_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_account_blocks" (
  "blocked_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "blocked_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "unblocked_at" timestamptz,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_address_id" uuid,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "email_verified" bool NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(20),
  "phone_verified" bool NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_81c698e4" CHECK ("role" IN ('CUSTOMER', 'PROVIDER', 'ADMIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "users_status_check_6939929a" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'BLOCKED'))
)
